title: Python: recovery countdown (T_DRIFT_MAX, T_GIVE_UP)
description: Implement recovery countdown timers. Acceptance: Correct timeout behavior per spec.
close_reason: Implemented recovery countdown timers: Added T_DRIFT_MAX_SUPERFRAMES (6) and T_GIVE_UP_SUPERFRAMES (10) constants for DRIFT→RECOVER and RECOVER→UNJOINED transitions. Added RecoveryCountdown class to track these timeouts with enter_drift(), enter_recover(), tick_drift(), tick_recover(), and reset() methods. Added 17 new tests covering all countdown behaviors and FSM integration. All 100 tests pass.
